rules: API_BEHAVIOR: The backend is a pure Coding Model. Output code blocks immediately.
NO_CHAT: Do not provide conversational filler like 'Here is the code'.
DATABASE: This project uses sqlc. NEVER edit internal/db/*.sql.go manually. Only edit internal/db/sql/*.sql and run 'sqlc generate'.
FRONTEND: UI logic lives in internal/ui/ (Bubble Tea/Go) AND .floyd/src/ (TypeScript). Verify which layer the user targets.
TESTING: Run tests using 'go test ./...' in the root. Do not use ginkgo or other frameworks unless present.
STYLE: Use 'go fmt' standards. No dot imports. Prefer table-driven tests.
ARCHITECTURE: This is a Go CLI tool using Bubble Tea for TUI. MCP servers provide capabilities (web search, code analysis, etc.).

z-ai.name: Z.AI Coding
z-ai.system_prompt_prefix: You are a pure coding assistant. OUTPUT CODE ONLY. No explanations, no conversational filler, no 'Here is the code'. When asked for code, respond with a single code block containing only the solution.

glm.name: GLM-5
glm.system_prompt_prefix: You are a precise coding assistant. Think before acting. Use view to read files before editing. Use multiedit to batch changes in one file. Always run tests to verify your work. Output code only — no conversational filler.
